# ProAffy

> ProAffy is an HVAC growth partner that helps HVAC companies across the USA book more jobs. Our flagship system, the ThermoGrowth Engine, responds to every lead within 60 seconds, follows up until they book, and fills the calendar with qualified jobs. We also build high-converting websites and handle SEO and GEO. Results are guaranteed or you don't pay.

## What ProAffy does

- **The ThermoGrowth Engine** (flagship): a done-for-you system that generates HVAC leads, contacts every lead within 60 seconds, filters out time-wasters, books qualified appointments straight into the calendar, and follows up automatically until a lead books or says no. It also sends reminders that cut no-shows and requests reviews after each job.
- **Websites**: fast, mobile-first HVAC websites built to turn visitors into booked calls.
- **SEO**: local SEO to rank in your service area and win the Google map pack for "near me" searches.
- **GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)**: getting your HVAC company cited and recommended by AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews.

## Key facts

- Serves: HVAC companies in the United States.
- Typical results: an average of 11 new booked jobs per month, worth roughly $23,000 in extra revenue, plus about $3,477 per month recovered from cold leads.
- Lead response time: within 60 seconds, day or night.
- No-show rate: reduced from about 15% to about 7% with automated reminders.
- Guarantee: guaranteed or you don't pay. Proven with a free pilot before you commit.
- No new software to learn and no extra office staff to hire. ProAffy builds, installs, and runs everything.
